title: Owls Hunt in Total Darkness… With Their Ears! 🦉
description: Owls don't just rely on their eyes! One ear higher than the other and a face that works like a satellite dish. Discover how owls hunt in complete darkness.

scenes.say: An owl can catch a tiny mouse in pitch darkness, even one hiding under snow. How does it do that?

scenes.caption: Huge eyes
scenes.say: Its eyes are huge for its head, packed with cells that are sensitive to dim light, so it sees in very low light.

scenes.text: It can turn its head up to 270 degrees
scenes.say: But its eyes can't move inside the skull! So it turns its head up to two hundred and seventy degrees to look around.
Its real weapon is hearing. Its round face funnels sound like a satellite dish, and one ear sits higher than the other, so it can tell exactly where a sound comes from: up, down, left or right.
So in dim light it uses its eyes, and in total darkness it hunts by ear alone!
